hero.title: 24/7 Multilingual Voice Receptionist — white-labeled into Clinora clinics
hero.narrative: Every Clinora-powered clinic in your network gets a voice receptionist that picks up at 9 PM in Tamil, 11 PM in Hindi, on Sundays in English. It captures patient name, contact, symptom in their own words, urgency, preferred consultant — then writes a structured patient intake straight back into Clinora's EMR so the doctor walks into the next morning's OPD with a clean queue. Same flow clones across general physicians, ophthalmologists, diabetologists, dental, paediatrics — without retraining. The doctor's mobile gets a WhatsApp summary the moment a high-urgency call lands.

system_prompt_inputs.language_default: English with Tamil + Hindi switch on the first turn
system_prompt_inputs.tone: Warm, clinical-but-human. Mirrors a senior front-desk nurse at a busy Chennai OPD — calm, never robotic, never gushing.
must_capture: whether it's a new visit or follow-up
must_refuse: investment / pricing commitments outside published OPD fee bands

secondary.title: Silvora 24/7 Emergency + Family Line
secondary.outcome: One number for resident emergencies, family check-ins, and night-shift coordination
secondary.narrative: Silvora's retirement community gets a single voice line that handles three flows at once. Resident or staff reports an emergency → routes to the on-call medical team in under 30 seconds with location, vitals last logged, and a structured incident note posted to Silvora. Family member calling at 11 PM to check on a parent → reads the day's care notes (mood, meals, walk, vitals) from Silvora — no staff woken. Caregiver shift handover → captures the daily verbal report in Tamil/Hindi/English and writes it as a structured Silvora entry. Zero clinical advice.

secondary.title: Outbound Patient Follow-Up & Vaccination Reminders
secondary.outcome: Turns Clinora's 'Predictive Follow-Up' from a dashboard alert into a real phone call
secondary.narrative: Clinora flags a diabetic follow-up due, a missed vaccination, a chronic-care no-show. Voxdonna calls the patient in their preferred language, captures whether they're coming in, reschedules if needed, sends the slot link by WhatsApp. Three-attempt fallback. Writes outcome back to Clinora so the doctor sees adherence patterns by patient. Same agent handles post-procedure check-ins for laparoscopic cases (Dr. Jothinathan's specialty).

secondary.title: PeopleHealth Telehealth Pre-Consult Triage
secondary.outcome: Doctor walks into the video call already knowing what's wrong
secondary.narrative: Patient books a telehealth slot in PeopleHealth. Five minutes before the video call, Voxdonna calls and captures presenting concern, duration, severity, current medications, allergies, recent reports — all in the patient's preferred language. Posts a structured pre-consult summary into the doctor's PeopleHealthPro queue. Saves 4–6 minutes of consult time per patient, lets specialists see more cases per day without overrun.
